invariants.fit_feature: [1, observed x_t, observed x_t-observed x_(t-1), current scalar control]
invariants.fit_order: chronological over frozen training episodes and target rows
invariants.reveal_order: predict and hash immutable artifact before target reveal; then optional slot-local update
invariants.normalization: training-only statistics; no development/final outcome statistics
invariants.unbounded_failure: record non-finite or numerical divergence as a cell failure; never rescue it with post-hoc clipping

R.name: recursive_self_feeding_and_predicted_delta_propagation
R.on: At each horizon step, feed the preceding predicted level and its predicted delta into the unchanged affine rule.
R.off: Compute exactly one next level from the last two revealed observations and current control, then persist that predicted level for all remaining requested steps; do not feed a prediction or predicted delta back into the rule.

U.name: post_reveal_slot_local_rls
U.on: After the immutable prediction artifact is recorded and the target is revealed, apply the exact historical RLS update sequentially to the slot-local precision and weights.
U.off: Do not mutate precision or weights after reveal and charge zero update operations; all fit/query constants and event order remain unchanged.

C.name: origin_relative_displacement_bound
C.on: At every produced step clip cumulative displacement from the last revealed origin to [-4,4] channel-wise.
C.off: Apply no saturation or replacement. Preserve finite raw predictions; record non-finite or declared numerical divergence as failure.

equivalence_controls.historical_fixture_requirement: Before any score, predictions, post-reveal state and operation accounting must match the exact Git-resolved historical rule on synthetic/outcome-free fixtures.
equivalence_controls.classical_control: A separately named affine VAR(2)/ARX implementation with the same ridge, slot-local RLS and bound must match R1-U1-C1 prediction/state within absolute and relative tolerance 1e-12.
equivalence_controls.interpretation_if_equal: The historical implementation is a classical model identity; quality equality is not evidence of a new architecture.
equivalence_controls.persistence_control: Observed last level repeated across the horizon.
equivalence_controls.one_step_hold_control: One affine next-level prediction from observed history, repeated across the horizon.

nonlinear_control_decision.reason: The registered question isolates three operations inside an already affine classical rule. Adding feature degree or regularization would change a second fundamental factor and would not distinguish recurrence, RLS or clipping.
nonlinear_control_decision.future_trigger: Only if a development-only residual remains after the exact VAR identity and factorial contrasts may a new, preregistered and fully charged nonlinear NARX control be added before any final access.

outcomes.primary: normalized RMSE, lower is better, reported per physical recording and horizon
secondary: finite rollout rate and divergence count
wall time as hardware-specific diagnostic only

estimands.recurrence_main: mean over matched U,C cells and independent physical recordings of NRMSE(R0)-NRMSE(R1); positive favors recurrence
estimands.update_main: mean over matched R,C cells and independent physical recordings of NRMSE(U0)-NRMSE(U1); positive favors post-reveal RLS
estimands.bound_main: mean over matched R,U cells and independent physical recordings of NRMSE(C0)-NRMSE(C1); positive favors bounding
estimands.unit: one independently recorded physical file/run; windows, horizons and runner permutations are repeated measures, not independent samples
estimands.uncertainty: paired per-recording contrasts with all units shown; bootstrap/permutation may resample physical recordings only and is disallowed when fewer than five independent recordings exist

seed_policy.note: Three runner seeds over the same physical files never satisfy replication.

effect_threshold.required_before_scoring: Freeze a smallest effect of interest from prospective measurement noise plus development-only scale before final data access. If this cannot be justified in service cycle 2, do not score.

decision_rules: If the exact VAR/ARX control and R1-U1-C1 differ beyond tolerance, invalidate the harness rather than interpret quality.
If U and/or C explain the gap while recurrence has no meaningful paired effect, conclude classical adaptation/stabilization is sufficient.
If recurrence has a preregistered positive paired effect after interactions and controls, retain only a narrow causal dynamics claim; do not claim economics or transfer.
If the effect disappears on genuinely new same-protocol physical traces, close this tested version.
If fresh same-protocol traces remain unavailable, permit historical causal diagnosis only and mark replication unresolved; do not substitute wt_walks_v1.
A quality win with greater full workload or memory is not an economic advantage.
invalidation: target or future-control access before artifact freeze
semantic file, seed, channel or family routing visible to the candidate
post-outcome split, threshold, feature, constant or baseline selection
non-source-identical factor implementations outside the named switch
missing failed/divergent cell, omitted cost, cross-slot mutation or evaluator digest change
treating windows, horizons or runner permutations as independent physical units
